about: Forecasts published by other institutions for India's real GDP growth and CPI inflation. The site does not forecast GDP or inflation itself; its own projections, for series nobody forecasts, are further down. India's fiscal year runs April to March, and every row is on that basis unless its note says otherwise.

outturn.text: MoSPI's Provisional Estimates of 5 June 2026 put real GDP growth for 2025-26 at 7.7 per cent; growth in April to June 2026, the first quarter of 2026-27, was 7.8 per cent (NSO, 31 August 2026).

budget.text: The Union Budget for 2026-27 assumes nominal GDP growth of 10 per cent and sets a fiscal deficit of 4.3 per cent of GDP.
budget.quote: The GDP for FY 2026-27 is estimated at ₹393,00,393 crore, which is 10% over the Advance Estimates for FY 2025-26

rows.who: Reserve Bank of India, Monetary Policy Committee
rows.quote: real GDP growth for 2026-27 is projected at 7.1 per cent ... CPI inflation is projected to be 5.2 per cent for 2026-27
rows.note: Q1 2027-28 growth projected at 7.1 per cent; the RBI publishes no full-year figure for 2027-28.

rows.quote: In India, growth is expected to slow to 7.1 percent in FY2026/27, 0.5 percentage points higher than previously expected.
rows.note: Takes 2025-26 as 7.8 per cent, against MoSPI's Provisional Estimate of 7.7.

rows.quote: growth is projected to fall from 7.8% in fiscal year (FY) 2025-26 to 7.1% in FY 2026-27 and 6.5% in FY 2027-28.
rows.note: Inflation is for calendar 2026 (4.2 per cent for 2027). Takes 2025-26 as 7.8 per cent.

rows.quote: India's growth is projected at 7.0% in FY2026 (ending 31 March 2027)
rows.note: ADB calls 2026-27 'FY2026'. The 2027-28 growth figure is from DD News's report of the release (23 September 2026); ADB's page states 4.0 per cent inflation for 2027-28.

rows.pub: World Economic Outlook, October 2026, Chapter 1, Table 1.1 and Annex Table 1.1.2
rows.quote: India 7.8 7.0 7.0 ... For India, data and projections are presented on a fiscal year (FY) basis, with FY 2025/26 (starting in April 2025) shown in the 2025 column.
rows.note: Consumer prices are from Annex Table 1.1.2, also on a fiscal-year basis. Takes 2025-26 as 7.8 per cent, against MoSPI's Provisional Estimate of 7.7. On a calendar-year basis the IMF projects 7.4 per cent for 2026.
